notes.title: Version 1.3.1 released!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of version 1.3.1 of our game!

• More tutorials have been added and expanded.
• Tutorial popups now appear during levels.
• An option to turn off tutorial popups has been added.
• Fixed a bug where teleporting between portals in the hub of the first act caused music transitions to not work properly.
• Fixed a bug where leaderboard windows sometimes wouldn’t close automatically.

Regarding the issue with Steam Link, we are postponing the fix to the next update, as it is a Steam-only feature.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 released!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of BitLiberator version 1.2.0!

This update introduces a major new feature: gamepad support!


 You can now plug in a gamepad and play the game with it.
 New gamepad options have been added, allowing you to configure buttons, dead zones, and cursor speed.


We’ve also included various quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes:


 You can now hold the left mouse button to select multiple allies at once.
 In hub levels, clicking on a portal to an available level will instantly move you to it. Clicking on an activated portal will teleport you directly to that level.
 Added an option to automatically move to a portal when hovering the cursor over it.
 Fixed a bug that could crash the game when creating links in the Battleship level.
 Fixed a bug where regained energy from removing upgrades wasn’t visible during active pause.
 Active pause is now mentioned in tutorials.
 Added options to set key bindings for Enter and Shift.
 Added an option to customize the colors of background texts.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Following the feedback we've received, we're introducing the following bug fixes and improvements:

• In sub-menus, you can now press Escape to return to the previous menu.
• You can use the left mouse button to start the game during the title drop.
• Added an option to change the upgrade colors for Allies and Enemies.
• Fixed a potential bug that prevented the game from starting due to a different language setting on your Windows system.
